ns2:course.label: Training in Business/Industry
ns2:course.description: Study of the status of education, training and development within business and industry; includes an overview of the systemic process for planning, delivery, and evaluation of training programs; and explores major problems, trends, and issues associated with the field.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: 3-hour section: Approved for the B.S. in Learning and Education Studies.
